title: Without Delete, the tracking switch shows but cannot be changed
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-NODEL-SWITCH) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-SWITCH-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-SW-T1) is tracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-SW-U1) is untracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-B}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Look at the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click the switch.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Search {Part-B} and click its row.
  6. Look at the switch.
  7. Click the switch.
  8. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The switch is shown, on, and disabled (greyed).
  • Step 3: Nothing changes: the switch stays on and Min and Max stay visible.
  • Step 6: The switch is shown, off, and disabled, so {User-B} can read that {Part-B} is untracked.
  • Step 7: The switch stays off and Min and Max stay hidden.
  • Step 8: Both parts are unchanged: {Part-A} still shows "2 Available" and {Part-B} still "Not Tracked".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-R8, S8-R9, S5-N2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.2 (Switch off), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R8: “Changing an existing part's tracking, in either direction, requires the same permission.”
  • S8-R9: “A user without that permission sees the tracking switch disabled, so they can read the state but not change it.”
  • S5-N2: “A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the switch disabled (S8-R9).”
